research.title: Predictive Uncertainty Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to examine interval coverage under controlled shifts in tabular regression feature distributions.
Compared split conformal prediction across regression baselines, tracking coverage and interval width across predefined shift conditions and repeated splits.

research.title: Missing Data and Probability Calibration in Tabular Classification
bullets: Planned experiments with supervisor guidance to compare imputation strategies under random and feature-dependent missingness in tabular classification.
Evaluated logistic regression and tree ensemble predictions using calibration curves and Brier scores, separating imputation fitting from held-out evaluation.

publications.title: Probability Calibration Under Simulated Missingness: Comparing Imputation Strategies for Tabular Classification

work.title: Batch Data Validation and Processing
bullets: Implemented assigned validation checks for incoming tabular records, handling missing fields, inconsistent types, and duplicate entries within existing processing routines.
Added regression tests for malformed inputs and updated error messages to support troubleshooting during routine batch processing.

projects.title: Regularization for Regression with Correlated Features
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression workflows with standardized features and cross-validation for selecting regularization strength on tabular datasets.
Compared prediction error and coefficient stability under correlated predictors, using repeated data splits and training-only preprocessing to limit leakage.

projects.title: Kernel Methods for Nonlinear Regression
bullets: Implemented kernel ridge regression with linear and radial basis function kernels, checking predictions against a reference library implementation.
Compared generalization error across kernel choices and bandwidth settings using synthetic nonlinear functions with controlled observation noise.

projects.title: Classification Under Class Imbalance
bullets: Implemented class weighting and random undersampling within classification pipelines, applying resampling only to training partitions during evaluation.
Compared logistic regression and random forest models using precision-recall curves, examining threshold sensitivity across datasets with differing class proportions.
